topics.name: Legacy Bootstrap Migration
topics.purpose: Define migration of prior in-tree Contract Format/bootstrap artifacts into explicit historical storage without preserving conflicting active authority.

semantics.migration_rule: Legacy artifact may be preserved byte-for-byte or provenance-preserving under history/bootstrap.
semantics.active_rule: After migration, legacy artifact no longer participates in active Contract Format bootstrap.
semantics.authority_rule: Repository-root Contract Format remains the sole active bootstrap authority under the declared profile.
semantics.failure_rule: If both legacy and root artifacts claim active bootstrap authority, repository acceptance hard-fails.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: legacy bootstrap left active in canonical/json
migration changes legacy bytes without provenance
